'''Jace Lorrin''' was [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] and [[Viceprex/Legends|Viceprex]] for the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]].

Jace spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Sullustese/Legends|Sullustese]] and [[Twi'leki/Legends|Ryl]], and could also read and write Basic and Sullustese. His equipment included a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], [[Code cylinder/Legends|code cylinder]], and [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].
